items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: The first band I played with was Foster Lewis and Dude. Because Roussel, or Bud Roussel was playing bass with them. That was the first band I would play with.

ctx.x: Yeah they flopped in that place and then made a hit at the concert, didn't they? Yeah, it was something. You remember a fellow named Foster and his brother Dude? Yeah.

Yeah I spoke about them on the earlier reel. I used to play with them. The first band I played with was Foster Lewis and Dude. Because Roussel, or Bud Roussel was playing bass with them. That was the first band I would play with.
Who was in that band? I didn't get that straight.
